tiertagger.config.gamemode.none:
§cFetching gamemodes failed, selected tierlist may be down.§r
OctoTagger will still work, but you can try restarting your game.
tiertagger.config.highest.desc:
- Never: only display tiers in the selected gamemode
- When Not Found: if a person isn't ranked in the current selected gamemode, show their highest tier overall
- Always: display a person's highest tier, regardless of the gamemode
tiertagger.config.position.desc:
- Left: only the left gamemodes, on the left of the name
- Right: only the right gamemodes, on the right of the name
- Both: left gamemodes on the left, right gamemodes on the right
Each side can show up to 2 tiers.
